thread:
Olivia: Quick handoff — I'm switching primary to Sam in ~10m. Leaving notes below for the active INC-2026-84 (us-west latency spike). brief: p99 high on /generate, some 500s on short requests. I triggered the incident channel and left the infra logs link.
incident-bot: Pager triggered INC-2026-84 — region: us-west — symptom: p99 latency > 1200ms for /generate — severity: sev2 — <https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-84>
opsbot: Deploy #457 finished at 2026-03-14T02:15Z — changes: kv-prefetch patch + batching kernel tweak — triggered marginalness on long-tail seqs.
Sam: thanks — on my way to take primary. two quick Qs: 1) is there an obvious rollback? 2) any customer impact numbers?
Olivia: 1) rollback = re-route to model-compat-1 (no kv-prefetch) — I have the command below. 2) impact: ~2% requests saw 500/timeouts last 20m, top affected customers in us-west (billing/ingest pipelines). posted list in #customer-impact.
Jess: tagging escalation matrix — if mitigation > 20m escalate to Nate for infra-level rollback. For any SRE lead notif, include request ids and sample traces.
Nate: standing by. if you need me to cut dedicated pool or kill the new batcher, ping me and I'll take over network windows.
Sam: copying runbook link now and will execute fallback in 2 steps. please confirm exact commands for safe order.
Olivia: Runbook (concise): <https://wiki.redwood.company/runbooks/kv-cache-fallback> — Steps I use in order: 1) set routing fallback; 2) drain new connections; 3) clear suspect prefixes; 4) monitor p99 and error rate.
Olivia: Quick commands (use with care):
```
# 1) route traffic off the new path to model-compat-1
rwctl route set --region us-west --service runtime --target model-compat-1 --reason "fallback INC-2026-84"
# 2) drain pods (graceful)
kubectl -n runtime rollout pause deployment/fast-batcher && kubectl -n runtime scale deployment/fast-batcher --replicas=0
# 3) clear suspect prefix/key from KV cache
redis-cli -h kv-cache.us-west.internal DEL "prefix:problem-tenant-123"
# 4) sanity-check: curl health endpoints and sample trace
curl -sS https://runtime-us-west.redwood.internal/health | jq .
```
Sam: executing step 1 now (routing). will wait 30s then step 2 drain, monitoring p99. I'll post updates.
Sam: (30s) routing set — links: <https://console.redwood.internal/routes?region=us-west> — p99 dropping already from ~1.3s to ~800ms.
Olivia: nice. once p99 stabilizes under 600ms sustain, we can leave fallback for the next deploy window. If it bounces back, escalate.
Sam: draining fast-batcher now.
incident-bot: Event: route change detected for INC-2026-84 by Sam at 2167890240 — new target model-compat-1 — monitoring initiated.
Sam: drain done. p99 now ~420ms, error rate down to 0.3%. keeping eyes on related sidecar logs for cache miss storms.
Jess: Good shepherding. Note for handoff: if secondary is stepping in, keep the sequence: route -> drain -> clear prefixes -> monitor. That avoids cache stampedes. Adding runbook pointer to thread.
Olivia: Coverage note — I'm handing off primary to Sam fully. Secondary remains Nate for escalation; Jess is SRE lead on deck for communication. There is a small coverage gap for the next 15m during my laptop swap: Sam is active but reachability for me is limited. If anything >10m ping Nate immediately.
Nate: confirmed. I'm reachable via phone and slack. Phone: +1-555-0199 (use only for >15m or customer-critical).
Sam: noted and accepted. I'll keep the incident channel updated every 5m until stable for 30m.
Olivia: thanks all — leaving two more quick links: canary rollback cheat: <https://wiki.redwood.company/playbooks/canary-rollback> and customer notify template: <https://wiki.redwood.company/comms/incident-notify-template>.
Sam: copying templates and will send an initial customer heads-up for affected enterprise tenants after 10m baseline.
incident-bot: INC-2026-84 status: mitigation in progress — current severity: sev2 -> monitoring.
Jess: if we hit >1% errors again after 10m, escalate to infra-exec and open an external incident page.
Sam: will update in 5. taking over as primary now. Olivia — enjoy your swap. :thumbsup:
Olivia: cheers, thanks for taking this. I'm around if needed but Sam owns it. Leaving this thread pinned to the channel for anyone joining the shift.
